scope: AI-assisted visual review of 23 sampled frames / 46 visible lamp states. Not independently annotated, held out, or event ground truth.
notes: Both listed visible heads show the listed state at these sampled frames, verified from enlarged original crops.
The review covers red and green only; it does not validate amber, flashing states, phase timing, or event boundaries.
The same samples informed calibration changes: this is a development spot check, not an unbiased generalisation estimate.
These labels are used only by tools/review_signals.py, never by inference.
